audio.strategy: Recorded sample playback for Grand, Upright, and Electric; live synthesis for Clav, Digital, Misc, Organ (B3/Vox/Farf/Pipe), and Synth analog engines; one AudioContext with per-layer effect chains, a shared organ chain, master gain, and limiter.

generatedSources.name: clav-digital-misc-and-fallback
generatedSources.description: Clav uses a square oscillator through a band-pass; Digital is additive sines; Misc is FM mallet. The same additive path is the labeled fallback if recorded banks fail to load. None of these are recordings.

generatedSources.name: organ-b3-vox-farf-pipe
generatedSources.description: B3 is nine sine tonewheel partials plus percussion and key-click noise. Vox is triangle/saw transistor partials. Farf is square-wave registers through band-pass filters. Pipe 1 is sine ranks with chiff. Pipe 2 reuses the B3 additive path with a brighter mix. Generated, not recorded.

generatedSources.name: synth-analog
generatedSources.description: Pure/Sync/Multi/Super/FM-H analog-mode oscillators, biquad filters, ADR envelopes, LFO, and a scheduled arpeggiator/gate. White noise and pulse waves are generated buffers. Not recordings.

sampleSources.name: Grand — FluidR3 GM acoustic grand
sampleSources.source: FluidR3 GM acoustic_grand_piano notes packaged by midi-js-soundfonts (Frank Wen / Michael Deal). Recorded piano, not generated.
sampleSources.notes: 17 recorded roots, one velocity layer. Additional dynamics via gain/filter, not extra recordings.

sampleSources.name: Upright — Upright piano KW (Kawai)
sampleSources.source: FreePats Upright piano KW, recorded from a Kawai upright in a living room by Gonzalo and Roberto (2017).
sampleSources.notes: Recorded vL and vH layers where the source bank provides them.

sampleSources.name: Electric — FluidR3 GM electric piano 1
sampleSources.source: FluidR3 GM electric_piano_1 (recorded tine EP) packaged by midi-js-soundfonts.
sampleSources.notes: Recorded tine electric piano, audibly distinct from the acoustic banks.

notes: Generated buffers are never described as recordings.
Organ and Synth share the Phase 2 AudioContext, effect graph, master path, and destination.
Master Level is not stored in programs. Live slots auto-write edits. Dirty E compares the sounding patch to the last loaded slot.
Unsupported panel controls: program-morph-at (aftertouch morph), organ-preset-1 and organ-preset-2 (preset/Drawbar Live library).
